Oneliner

Validate CubeSat platform technologies and test propulsion module plus cameras.
Description

Validate the Endeavor suite technologies that will be used for future missions and is solely for the purpose of internal Tyvak development as an attitude control experiment. Includes VACCO propulsion module. Validate the Command and Data Handling (CDH) system, Guidance Navigation and Control (GNC) software and actuators, as well as test visible & IR cameras.
